# Clean Code for Codex

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/clean-code/ in the guided-plugins repository (https://github.com/Nouran99/guidedplugins).

- Skills: 31 workflow and rule skills plus 6 mode skills, invoked as `$clean-code:<name>` or from `/skills`.
- Subagents: 22 roles. Codex plugins cannot bundle subagents, so they are not part of this plugin. They are in a clone of the repository, as `dist/codex/agents/clean-code-*.toml`; install them by running `node scripts/install-codex-agents.mjs clean-code` inside that clone.
- Always-on rules: `dist/rules/clean-code/` in the repository (`AGENTS.nano.md` or `AGENTS.mini.md`), to copy into your `AGENTS.md`.

Full instructions: docs/AGENTS_SUPPORT.md in the repository.
